security_findings.finding: TARGET_FOLDER_PATTERN (^\d{4}-\d{2}$) accepted semantically invalid months (e.g. '2026-13') — this is the last validation gate before the plan reaches user approval and, later, the not-yet-written Security layer.
security_findings.fix: Regex tightened to ^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$, validating month range 01-12. Regression tests added for '2026-13' and '2026-00' in the parametrized targetFolder test.

security_findings.finding: Empty-PDF-list shortcut silently returns real DateSource.CREATED_AT/SortOrder.ASCENDING enum values that represent no actual decision, risking downstream misinterpretation by future Security/Orchestrator code that doesn't also check steps==[].
security_findings.fix: Added a docstring on DateSource in models.py itself (not just a comment at the one call site in plan_generation.py) explicitly warning that these fields carry no real decision when steps is empty — visible to anyone reading the schema definition directly.

approved_points: generate_plan_skeleton's ValidationError-to-PlanGenerationError conversion correctly covers the new required fields — any missing/unknown dateSource, missing/unknown sortOrder, or malformed targetFolder raises PlanGenerationError before reaching any caller.
DateSource being a single-member enum (vs a plain Literal) is a defensible, forward-extensible choice — functionally equivalent validation, easier to extend later.

Test diff verified against actual files — VALID_PLAN_JSON updates and new test functions (missing/unknown dateSource, missing/unknown sortOrder, malformed targetFolder cases) all match claims; pre-existing test intent (metadata-only prompt, LLM error wrapping, model env override) preserved unchanged.
Schema-tightening correctly funnels malformed dateSource/sortOrder/targetFolder into PlanGenerationError before reaching Security, matching the task's stated goal.
overall_assessment: Both low-severity findings were cheap to close immediately rather than deferred: month-range regex fixed (real correctness gap, last gate before user/Security), and the empty-plan default values now carry an explicit warning docstring in models.py. 52/52 tests green.
